source.rationale: The escalate_message annotation belongs to the require-specific picker and nothing else. On an ordinary miss the message is whatever not-found-error-message wrote, and rewriting numbered lines in it would staple has/no suffixes onto text that is not a picker at all. With require_specific false the message must come through untouched even though the probe succeeded and both codes were probed.
